name: Full Vehicle Wraps
short: Applied Graphics in Kenilworth, New Jersey wraps cars, vans, trucks and SUVs in printed 3M vinyl, designed in-house and installed by 3M-certified crews.
long: Applied Graphics wraps full vehicles at its 6,000-square-foot indoor shop in Kenilworth, New Jersey, using printed 3M vinyl. Every installer is 3M-certified, and the shop works with 3M MCS warranty materials. Design is handled by a full in-house art department, concept to completion, on jobs the company describes as ranging from one custom art piece to a fleet of 500. In business since 1978.

name: Fleet Graphics
short: Applied Graphics produces fleet graphics out of Kenilworth, New Jersey, designing, printing and installing them from one shop for operations of any size.
long: Fleet graphics from Applied Graphics are designed, printed and installed out of one 6,000-square-foot shop in Kenilworth, New Jersey. The building takes vehicles up to 53 feet long, and 3M-certified installers also work on the road at your location when vehicles cannot come in. The company puts its range at anything from one custom art piece to a fleet of 500. In business since 1978.

name: Partial Wraps, Vinyl & Lettering
short: Partial wraps, decals and cut vinyl lettering from Applied Graphics in Kenilworth, New Jersey — vehicle branding without covering every panel.
long: Applied Graphics in Kenilworth, New Jersey installs partial wraps, decals and vinyl lettering for owners who don't need all four sides covered. The same in-house art department and 3M-certified installers handle a door logo, a phone number or a full side panel, and the shop also removes vinyl when it is time for something else. It has been in business since 1978.

name: Color-Change Wraps
short: Applied Graphics in Kenilworth, New Jersey applies full vinyl wraps over a vehicle's existing paint, and lists vinyl removal as a service too.
long: A color change at Applied Graphics in Kenilworth, New Jersey is a full vinyl wrap: 3M film applied over the vehicle's existing paint by 3M-certified installers, using 3M MCS warranty materials. Vinyl removal is a service the shop lists as well. Design, printing and installation all happen in the same 6,000-square-foot indoor facility, and the company has been in business since 1978.

name: Food Truck Wraps
short: Applied Graphics wraps food trucks in Kenilworth, New Jersey, with designers the company credits with over 20 combined years of wrap experience.
long: Applied Graphics designs and installs food truck wraps at its Kenilworth, New Jersey shop, where the company says its food-truck designers have over 20 combined years of vehicle-wrap experience between them. The graphics are printed in-house on 3M MCS warranty materials and installed by 3M-certified crews inside a 6,000-square-foot heated and cooled facility. In business since 1978.

name: Race Car & Performance Graphics
short: Applied Graphics in Kenilworth, New Jersey produces race car graphics, track lettering and sponsor decals, installed by 3M-certified crews.
long: Applied Graphics produces race car graphics, track lettering and sponsor decals from Kenilworth, New Jersey — by the company's own description, 27 minutes from Manhattan. Work is installed by 3M-certified crews in a 6,000-square-foot heated and cooled shop. One customer, writing in January 2018, said a track-prepped Roush Stage 3 was wrapped here and that the wrap held up to track events all season.

name: Trains, Buses & Box Trucks
short: Applied Graphics wraps box trucks, buses and rail cars in Kenilworth, New Jersey, in a shop that takes vehicles up to 14 feet high and 53 feet long.
long: Applied Graphics handles the largest vehicles inside its 6,000-square-foot facility in Kenilworth, New Jersey, which takes units up to 14 feet high and 53 feet long — box trucks, buses and rail cars included. Its printers run up to 60 inches wide and 150 feet long. When a vehicle cannot come to Kenilworth, 3M-certified installers go to it, on the road at your location.

name: Interior & Exterior Building Graphics
short: Applied Graphics produces wall murals, 3D lettering, kiosks and building signage in Kenilworth, New Jersey, with site surveys and on-site installation.
long: Applied Graphics brands buildings inside and out from Kenilworth, New Jersey: interior and exterior wall murals, 3D lettering, kiosks, storefront windows, and building and wall signage. Printing runs up to 60 inches wide and 150 feet long. Site surveys and mobile installation are both listed services, so measuring and installing happen at your location. The company has been in business since 1978.

name: Architectural Finishes & 3M DI-NOC
short: Applied Graphics in Kenilworth, New Jersey installs and replaces 3M DI-NOC architectural finishes, with over 500 surfaces to choose from.
long: Applied Graphics installs and replaces 3M DI-NOC architectural finishes from Kenilworth, New Jersey, surfacing existing interiors, storefront windows and exteriors with film instead of replacing them. The company points to over 500 DI-NOC surfaces to choose from. All installers are 3M-certified, and site surveys and on-site installation are both listed services. Applied Graphics has been in business since 1978.

name: Window Graphics & Perforation
short: Applied Graphics in Kenilworth, New Jersey applies window perforation, frosted and opaque graphics and cut lettering to storefront glass.
long: Applied Graphics turns storefront glass into signage from its Kenilworth, New Jersey shop, using cut vinyl lettering, opaque and frosted window graphics, and perforated window film. Prints run up to 60 inches wide, and 3M-certified installers work on-site; the company gives its service area as New Jersey, New York, Philadelphia, Connecticut and Boston, plus a national installer network. In business since 1978.

name: Banners, Signs & Magnets
short: Applied Graphics prints banners, magnets and building signage up to 60 inches wide by 150 feet long in Kenilworth, New Jersey.
long: Applied Graphics prints banners, vehicle magnets, building and wall signage and other large-format graphics up to 60 inches wide and 150 feet long at its Kenilworth, New Jersey shop. The company says it produced graphics for World Cup activity at MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford, New Jersey, during the 2026 tournament; that account is the company's own. Printing is in-house and installation is by 3M-certified installers.

name: In-House Design & Installation
short: Applied Graphics keeps design, printing and 3M-certified installation in one 6,000-square-foot building at 718 B Jefferson Ave, Kenilworth, New Jersey.
long: Applied Graphics runs a full in-house art department and 3M-certified installation crews at 718 B Jefferson Ave in Kenilworth, New Jersey, taking a project from concept to completion in one building. The shop is 6,000 square feet, indoor, heated and cooled. Crews also install on the road at your location, and site surveys are a listed service. The company has been in business since 1978.
